en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Abdul Azeem Bin Abdullah Al Hassany, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Zayd Al Shahham who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said to me and we were in the road during the night of Friday: ‘Recite the Quran, for it is a night of Friday’.

So I recited [44:40] Surely the Day of separation is their appointed term, of all of them [44:41] The Day on which a friend shall not avail (his) friend aught, nor shall they be helped, [44:42] Except those on whom Allah shall have Mercy.

So Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘We<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, by Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, are those on whom Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> has Mercy, and we, by Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, are those whom Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> has Made to be exception, in order for us<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> to make them (Shias) needless from them (rest of the people)’.
en.sarwar: 56. Ahmad ibn Mihran has narrated from ‘Abd al-‘Azim al-Hassani from ‘Abdallah from Yahya ibn Salim from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following
“When this, “but only attentive ears will retain it” [69:12] the Messenger of Allah said, “They are your ears, O Ali.”
